name: Strip Battle Days 2
original_name: ストリップバトルデイズ2
source:
Makoto Itou wanders into a parallel world where everything is decided by rock-paper-scissors.  Become Makoto as he strips girls in rock-paper-scissors and unravels the mysteries of this world.

[From [url=http://sanahtlig.blogspot.com/2016/02/rock-paper-scissors-eroge-strip-battle-days-2.html]Sanahtlig's Corner[/url]]
translation:
伊藤诚漫游到了一个平行世界，一切都由石头剪刀布决定。化身Makoto，用石头剪刀布剥光女孩的衣服，揭开这个世界的谜团。

[来自[url=http://sanahtlig.blogspot.com/2016/02/rock-paper-scissors-eroge-strip-battle-days-2.html]Sanahtlig的角落[/url]]
